title: [gpt-image-1] `revised_prompt` sometimes returns null — causes Zod validation error (`invalid_type`)

linked_prs.title: fix(openai): allow 'revised_prompt' to be returned as null
linked_prs.body:
## Background

AI-SDK's internal Zod schema expects `revised_prompt` to always be a non-null string. However, this is not always the case because [revised_prompt is only returned when using the model `dall-e-3` ](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/images/object#images-object-data-revised_prompt)

As a result, the SDK throws a validation error.

#9441 

## Summary

set `revised_prompt` to have the nullish property

## Manual Verification

didn't need an e2e example. test has been updated to show where the error was occurring
